title: LuckRead D1-03 W11 Campaign and Growth Logical Owner Reconciliation

scope.purpose: Account for W11's frozen D1-03 Campaign/GrowthOperation ownership while preventing analytics-only D1-05 sources from being treated as D1-03 business persistence.

deferredPhysicalSchemaEntities.reason: The frozen T22 mapping assigns Campaign to W11 in D1-03, but the repository contains no admitted Campaign field/persistence contract, operation-level D1-03 governance access contract, or authoritative W11 D1-03 source migration. Campaign attribution and analytics dimensions in D1-05 are not Campaign business-state persistence.
requiredBeforeAdmission: Canonical T22 Feature ID and API operation contract for each Campaign mutation/read.
Campaign entity field and lifecycle contract covering identity, ownership, status transitions, retention, privacy and indexes.
Explicit W11 D1-03 governance access contract with operation-level authorization, caller identity and audit requirements.
Authoritative D1-03 source migration owned by W11, or a precise contract naming the existing primary schema owner and delegated operation scope.
Deterministic PostgreSQL 18 translation that contains only admitted Campaign business state.
Disposable PostgreSQL 18 catalog, constraint, idempotency and rollback rehearsal.

deferredPhysicalSchemaEntities.reason: The frozen T22 mapping assigns GrowthOperation to W11 in D1-03, but the repository contains no admitted GrowthOperation state machine, field/persistence contract, operation-level D1-03 governance access contract, or authoritative W11 D1-03 source migration. D1-05 analytics projection/rebuild state is not the authoritative growth-operation lifecycle.
requiredBeforeAdmission: Canonical T22 Feature ID and API operation contract for each GrowthOperation transition.
GrowthOperation field and state-machine contract, including eligibility, idempotency, terminal states, retry/replay, actor and audit semantics.
Explicit W11 D1-03 governance access contract with operation-level authorization, caller identity and audit requirements.
Authoritative D1-03 source migration owned by W11, or a precise contract naming the existing primary schema owner and delegated operation scope.
Deterministic PostgreSQL 18 translation that contains only admitted GrowthOperation business state.
Disposable PostgreSQL 18 catalog, transition, idempotency and rollback rehearsal.

d1_05Separation.authority: Analytics-only derived events, counters, rollups and rebuildable projections.
rules: T23 analytics-derived state remains in D1-05 and cannot be used as a substitute for T22 Campaign/GrowthOperation business state.
Every table created by the four admitted W11 migrations must remain analytics-prefixed.
W11 Wrangler and runtime environment remain D1_05-only until a separate reviewed D1-03 governance-access admission.
No Campaign or GrowthOperation physical table may be inferred from analytics dimensions, attribution fields, counters, or projection rebuild state.

nextGate: Keep Campaign and GrowthOperation physically deferred until their own T22 operation, field/state, D1-03 governance-access and source-migration contracts are admitted; then add a separate deterministic PostgreSQL 18 schema slice. Do not copy D1-05 analytics tables into D1-03.
